attestations.note: «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Μαρτίου εκάστου έτους.» The entry is one sentence and a couplet, with no asterisk and no disclaimer, and it gives no year, so there is no dates object. He is not the corpus's Aquila, the apostle and husband of Priscilla, whom the Romanian calendar keeps on 13 februarie and again on 14 iulie, nor Aquila of Trebizond.
